name: GN-CL-2 protocluster field, GOODS-North (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the submillimeter galaxy GN-CL-2 in a distant protocluster near GOODS-North, seen by Hubble.
label: gnclnorth-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field hides GN-CL-2, a dusty, furiously star-forming galaxy in a protocluster, a city of galaxies still under construction far across the universe. Hubble looked to see whether its stars betray a merger stoking the fire or a compact core about to go quiet.

claims.text: The GNCL-NORTH pointing contains GN-CL-2, a protocluster member
GN-CL-2 is a bright submillimeter galaxy with a confirmed redshift in the protocluster
Hubble program 16504 targets the two brightest submillimeter galaxies of a spectroscopically confirmed, massively star-forming protocluster in GOODS-North, to tell advanced mergers from compact cores
The protocluster region lies near GOODS-North, just outside the earlier HST/ACS and WFC3 footprints
